verdict.rationale: Loops ships event-triggered workflows. Sending an event starts published workflows, and you can create or update workflow graphs with branching nodes from code. Workflows can be built around product events such as onboarding, trial and re-engagement, and can also be triggered by incoming webhooks. Missing for 10: detailed docs on rule/condition types and the available non-email action nodes, and independent or hands-on corroboration of workflow automation.
